title: MiniQMT strategy rebalance does not sell holdings dropped from current selection
description:
Expected: When a miniQMT virtual strategy runs a StrategyPackage rebalance, AIstock must build a complete target portfolio from the current selection and compare it against all existing strategy-attributed holdings. Holdings that are absent from the new target universe, or whose target quantity is lower than current quantity, must generate SELL intents subject to T+1 available quantity, suspension/limit/can-sell checks, and broker/account constraints. A strategy must not silently keep retired/dropped symbols forever and must not degrade into buy-only behavior.
Actual: Current MiniQMT strategy order generation only iterates over symbols present in the current selection_run candidates. Existing strategy holdings that are no longer selected are never visited, so no SELL intent is generated for retired/dropped holdings. During the 2026-05-19 miniQMT SIM POC, BUY fills were observed for strategy A, but no SELL fills or automated sell intents were validated. Code inspection points to backend/services/qmt_strategy_ledger/selection_order_builder.py build_for_binding(): it loads current quantities but computes deltas only inside the current candidate loop, making the workflow an add/adjust-selected-symbols path rather than a complete rebalance path.
required_verification: Regression test: existing strategy holding absent from the new selection target generates a SELL intent for available shares.
Regression test: existing strategy holding still selected but above target generates a partial SELL intent.
Regression test: existing strategy holding equal to target is skipped and below target generates BUY using the canonical board-lot rule.
Regression test: T+1 unavailable or broker can-sell unavailable shares do not generate illegal SELL orders and produce an explicit skip/reason.
Integration check: same-symbol holdings across multiple strategies remain isolated by strategy lot attribution and order_remark/strategy_name.
miniQMT SIM POC: run a rebalance where at least one previously held stock is dropped and verify AIstock creates/submits the SELL intent and records the fill or broker rejection.
closure_requirements: SelectionOrderBuilder or its replacement implements complete rebalance semantics from full target map versus all strategy-attributed holdings.
Removed holdings and overweight holdings are not silently carried unless blocked by a recorded T+1/suspend/limit/can-sell reason.
BUY and SELL order generation uses one canonical board-lot/tradability rule source instead of duplicated simplified checks.
Strategy-level ledger, cash, positions, and PnL remain auditable after sell intents and fills are synchronized.
No simplified buy-only fallback path remains in the miniQMT strategy execution flow.

events.note: Raised from 2026-05-19 miniQMT SIM POC and user confirmation that strategy buy-only behavior is a severe P0 defect.

Classified as P0 trading rebalance correctness: a strategy that only buys and never sells can accumulate stale holdings, fail daily rebalance decisions, distort risk exposure, and make SIM/LIVE validation untrustworthy.

selection_order_builder.py build_for_binding() iterates only current selection candidates and computes deltas only for those symbols; existing holdings absent from the target universe are not compared and therefore do not produce SELL intents.
Mirrored BUG-050 to GitHub issue #53 via gh CLI.
Confirmed GitHub issue #53 is OPEN and label-synced (bug, status:open, P0, severity:p0, module:qmt_strategy_ledger, risk:trading_rebalance_correctness) before fix worktree creation.

Implemented complete MiniQMT StrategyPackage rebalance sell generation in SelectionOrderBuilder: dropped holdings emit SELL intents, overweight sells cap to T+1 available quantity with explicit skip reasons, same-symbol multi-strategy lots stay isolated. Local validation passed: targeted selection builder tests 12 passed, qmt_strategy_ledger suite 49 passed, compileall, diff checks, validation_module_registry_l0, guardrail_changed_files, and l0.
Committed BUG-050 local fix as f3367e1 on branch bug/BUG-050-miniqmt-rebalance-sell-dropped after local validation passed.

PR #86 merged into main with merge commit f322723a9431b5e534fe42cdaa6edbe6122ef77b after GitHub CI checks passed. GitHub issue #53 is closed by the PR; local registry remains fixed until runtime MiniQMT SIM POC verifies broker submit/fill or rejection path.
